eyebrow.zh: 分层长图 · 就地改 · 逐层对比
eyebrow.en: Layered long images · edit in place · compare layer by layer

headline.zh:
改一处数据。
只重渲那一层。
headline.en:
Change one data point.
Only that layer re-renders.

sub.zh: 扁平长图改一个数字就要整张重画、重新上传。layerlong 把它变成可编辑、可对比的分层长图——改一处数据，只有变化的那一层重新渲染，其余图层原样不动，改在哪、变了什么一眼可见。
sub.en: Flat long images make you redraw and re-upload the whole thing to change one number. layerlong turns them into editable, comparable layered images — change one data point and only that layer re-renders, the rest stay untouched, and what changed is visible at a glance.

title.zh: 改一处数据，只重渲那一层
title.en: Change one datum, rerender only that layer

body.zh: 以前改一个数字，要重开源文件、肉眼定位、改完再整张导出、重新上传。layerlong 把每个标题、数据行、标注都变成可寻址的图层——改一处数据，只有映射到它的那一层重新渲染，其余图层原样保留。
body.en: You used to reopen the source file, hunt the spot by eye, re-export the whole image, and re-upload just to fix one number. layerlong turns every title, data row, and annotation into an addressable layer — change one datum and only the layer mapped to it re-renders; the rest stay exactly as they were.

title.en: Which layer changed — visible at a glance

body.zh: 两版长图之间，逐图层告诉你哪些新增、删除、改动、未变；变化的那一层高亮出来，配上一句"X / Y 层变化 · 只重渲变化层"。改在哪、动了什么，不用再肉眼逐行比对。
body.en: Between two versions, it tells you per layer what was added, removed, changed, or left untouched — the changed layers are highlighted, with a banner reading "X / Y layers changed · only changed layers re-rendered." No more eyeballing line by line to find the edit.

chips: › 一句话点出动了哪几层

title.en: A source you can edit again and again

body.zh: 扁平图导出即终点——源锁在设计软件里，下次想改只能从头来。layerlong 给你一份可编辑、可保存的分层源：每个图层都能就地改、与上一版对比、再渲染，源始终在你手里，不被锁进任何工具。
body.en: A flat image is a dead end — the source stays locked inside the design tool, so the next edit starts from scratch. layerlong hands you an editable, saveable layered source: every layer can be changed in place, compared against the previous version, and re-rendered, and the source stays in your hands — never locked into any tool.

chips: › 可编辑分层源在你手里
› 就地改 · 可对比 · 可再渲

title.zh: 贴段文本，直接出分层长图
title.en: Paste some text, get a layered long image

body.zh: 粘一段 markdown 或表格，按公众号或小红书的画布与标题安全区排成分层长图；只有一段白话文字，也能一键抽成结构化草稿再渲染。默认离线、零密钥起步，要更准可换你自己的。
body.en: Paste a markdown snippet or a table and it's laid out into a layered long image on the WeChat or Xiaohongshu canvas, with titles kept inside the safe-zone. Got only plain prose? One step turns it into a structured draft you can render. Starts offline and zero-key; bring your own when you want more.

chips: › 公众号 + 小红书画布预设

headline.zh: 把扁平长图，换成分层长图。
headline.en: Swap flat long images for layered ones.

sub.zh: 开源 · MIT · 一条命令跑通。改一处数据，只重渲一层。
sub.en: Open source · MIT · runs in one command. Change one datum, rerender one layer.
